## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Memorial Submitting the Grotto-Heavens and Sea-Mountains*

by [李思聰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E6%80%9D%E8%81%B0) (Lǐ Sīcōng) — Northern-Sòng Daoist

The memorial accompanying the submission of [KR5d0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0086) *Dòng yuān jí* 洞淵集 to the throne, dated 1050. Preserved as **DZ 1062** / CT 1062 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部).

**Dating.** 1050. Dynasty: 北宋.
